long_description.before:
CoAsync by Cognitio Labs is the AI back office for product quality compliance teams.

We help mission-critical food manufacturers automate repetitive, document-intensive workflows.

We started with Certificates of Analysis (COAs), one of the many workflows quality teams manage before products can ship. Today, this work is still performed manually across PDFs, emails, spreadsheets, and disconnected ERP systems. 

Other documents we help quality teams respond to 24x7 include supplier audit questionnaires, production schedules, lab reports & changes in product specifications and quality records.

CoAsync automates the workflow by:

Reading supplier documents
Extracting laboratory data
Validating product specifications
Applying compliance requirements
Drafting compliant COAs
Organizing audit-ready documentation

Results from one of our initial deployments with a mid-market food processor:

85% less QA administrative work
4× more COAs processed per shift
1-2 hours saved per document
New product onboarding in under one day

COAs are just the beginning. Our vision is to build the AI back office for product quality and compliance across regulated industries by automating the many document-intensive workflows manufacturers manage every day.

Backed by Y Combinator and leading investors. Founder Diva Avaya Sharma has presented example AI workflows for product quality and compliance through the World Economic Forum Centre for Advanced Manufacturing and Supply Chains' SmartStart initiative and at the International Telecommunication Union's AI for Good Global Summit, organized in partnership with the United Nations.

Know a company shipping food & product urgently? Help them get started with their own document workflows at https://cognitioiq.com

long_description.before:
Inference research at the frontier. We make frontier open models faster and cheaper on Wally.

We're RunAnywhere (YC W26). You can use frontier open models like GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3 and MiniMax M3 on Wally today. Wally has an OpenAI-compatible API and the wally CLI, with zero data retention by default, and it works with OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes and Cline. Tell your agent: set up https://runanywhere.ai/SKILL.md

Our engineers and AI agents build the kernels and the serving stack for each chip. For AWS Trainium, trnRT is our open-source (Apache-2.0) LLM inference engine; Aman Swar and Sanchit Monga's post covers serving GLM-5.3-Flash on one Trainium2 box: https://runanywhere.ai/blog/glm-5-3-flash-trainium2-nki-megakernels

For on-device AI, the open-source RunAnywhere SDKs share a C++ core across Swift, Kotlin, React Native, Flutter, TypeScript and C++.

We publish how we measured each result. Happy to help any YC founder running coding agents, long-context workloads or on-device models.

long_description.before: At Talos, we are building better, more modern predictive maintenance for the power industry with a focus on large transformers. Our devices continuously monitor critical power equipment and detect problems early on using anomaly-detection models. For each fault, we provide detailed analyses of the problem, exactly where and why it happened, as well as next steps teams should take.
long_description.after:
Talos builds an early-warning system for power grid and utility infrastructure by putting retrofittable sensors on critical equipment to detect catastrophic failures early. 

Power outages cost Americans over $120 billion last year. With the rising necessity of compute, data centers are being added to the grid at record pace, doubling their electricity demand in the past five years. The additional demand is overstressing a grid operating past its intended life span. 

Utilities need insights not just for specific assets, but across their entire plant. Power plants especially are built around an intertwined chain of assets: any issue in one could affect all others. Talos is an all-in-one system built to monitor a variety of equipment such as transformers, turbines, pumps, generators, poles, and more. Our system tracks changes throughout a plant, allowing us to correlate issues between assets and providing engineers with more insights into an issue.

one_liner.after: Predictive maintenance for critical grid infrastructure.

long_description.before:
Oasive is an AI research platform that helps municipal bond investors decide which bonds to buy.

Before a fund buys a bond from a city, school district, hospital or airport, its analysts spend hours digging through PDFs, board meetings and local news. Oasive brings a borrower's audited financials, debt, board meetings and local news into one page built around what matters for that sector, with every number linked to its source.

Built by a former bond portfolio manager at Google Treasury and quant analyst at Wells Fargo.
